subject: Kickoff: after-kernel invariance diagnostics
body:
Hi Santiago, team,

Kicking off the after-kernel study. The one-liner: the after kernel is like the neural tangent kernel, but computed after training — and comparing the two tells us which invariances a trained network actually acquired versus inherited. The experiment suite measures invariance to translations, zooms, quadrant swaps of the input image, and rotations.

Why product cares: if this holds up, it becomes a model-diagnostics report we can attach to every finetuned model — a trust signal customers keep asking for.

Milestones: MNIST 3-vs-8 binary study complete by end of March, invariance report template mid-April, readout to Hana's staff the week of May 11.

Priya
